content: असाधारण {%a.%} .²1 Not common, peculiar; special, specific. .²2 (In logic) Existing neither in सपक्ष or विपक्ष as a {%hetu%}; यस्तूभयस्माद् व्यावृत्तः स त्वसाधारणो मतः .²3 Not to be claimed by anyone else, exclusively belonging to one (as wealth <ab>&c.</ab>); पिता पुत्रान्तरेष्वपि साधारणो माता त्वसाधारणी <ls>Mit.</ls> .{@-णः@} A fallacy or हेत्वाभास in Logic; one of the three kinds of अनैकान्तिक <ab>q. v.</ab> .{@-णम्@} Speciality, special property.
